# War Scroll Column 19 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 19 | **Condition:** heavily damaged

---

**19:1** [...] they shall rise-up [...] the hero-of-battle [...] and the gates [...]

**19:2** [...] You have strengthened [...] Your hand [...] upon the peoples [...]

**19:3** [...] You have [com]manded us [...] our generations [...] Your wonderful-deeds [...] and

**19:4** Your judgments [...] You have done-wondrously with the poor ones [...] and with those refined [...]

**19:5** [...] You have acted-mightily [...] in the night [...] and in the morning [...]

**19:6** [...] for the greatness-of [...] the covenant-of [...] our fathers [...]

**19:7** [...] the community-of-the-holy-ones [...] glorious-ones [...] in the assembly-of [...] knowledge [...]

**19:8** [...] the mighty-ones-of [...] the righteousness [...] and the wonder [...] Your glory [...]

**19:9** [...] the deeds-of [...] Your hand [...] the peoples-of [...]

**19:10** [...] righteous judgment [...] the congregation-of-Your-truth [...] chosen ones [...]

**19:11** [...] we have rejoiced [...] in Your covenant-faithfulness [...] and in Your salvation [...]

**19:12** [...] Your mighty-arm [...] has not turned-back [...] for all [...]

**19:13** [...] the appointed-times-of-Your-glory [...] the congregation-of [...] truth [...]

**19:14** [...] for all the times-of eternity [...]

---

*EMET notes: Column 19 is the final column of 1QM, very heavily damaged. Only fragments of most lines survive. The text continues the victory hymn from col. 18. Construct chains hyphenated. "Covenant-faithfulness" for chesed per project convention. This column marks the end of the War Scroll proper.*
